id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_010.pack|cs_: "The soldiers are down... Who could have done this?
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Heh heh heh. Easy job. All I do is hand this orb to the boss, and I can name my own reward.
"Hey! What are you talking about?! I'm taking that orb!
"Heh heh heh. Who are you two? Never mind. Curse your bad luck for coming here!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_040.pack|cs_: "Tch, they gave me trouble. But why were monsters after the orb?
"Oh well. I finally got it. It took long enough...
"The Red Orb I'd nearly given up on is right here in my hand... {var:1}, I'm sure now.
"As long as I'm with you, someday my wish will come true...
"Don't ask what the wish is. That's my own business.
"Well, my business is done. Let's head to your hometown.
"Well, my business is done. Let's go to Cobblestone Falls, like your grandpa said.
"Well, everything's done. Let's head to the Door of Departure to the east, like your grandpa said.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_060.pack|cs_: "Welcome home, {var:1}. Your favorite stew will be ready soon.
"You must be hungry. Come, hurry to the table...
"Wh-what are you saying?! My boy is only six years old!
"Are you making a fool of me?!
"Now get out of here at once! Or I'll call for help!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Oh, I know! You're looking for {var:1}, right?
"{var:1} should be at Grandpa Chalky's! This way!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_080.pack|cs_: "Grandpa! Do you know where the ladder is? The ladder!
"Gemma's scarf blew up into a tree!
"Ha ha ha, all right, all right. Wait there. I'm coming.
"{var:1}, never mind the ladder. That big brother got the scarf for me.
"And he says he came to see you! Do you know him?
"No, I don't.
"Hmm... That young man seems to have business with me. {var:1} and Gemma, go play over there.
"Okay!
"Now then...
"You're a {var:1} too, aren't you.
"Ha ha ha. What are you saying? Hide it all you like, I can tell. I've looked after you since you were a baby.
"Ha ha ha. I thought so. I've looked after you since you were a baby. I can always tell.
"Why such a pained face? What happened? Tell me about it.
Following Chalky's wishes, {var:1} told him what had happened since leaving Cobblestone.
"I see. It seems you've come from the future, after I'm gone.
"Hmm... The king of Heliodor, whom we relied on, betrayed you? I'm sorry to have made you suffer so.
"If the king can't be relied on, I'd best tell you everything, holding nothing back.
"But we don't seem to have much time to talk. Listen well, now.
"East of the village is Cobblestone Falls, yes? When you return, dig in front of the triangular rock there.
"Cobblestone Falls, to the east. The triangular rock there...
"How you've grown. I am a lucky man to see you grown so fine, {var:1}.
"{var:1}, do not hold a grudge against anyone. I was happy to be your grandpa.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Big brother! I forgot to thank you earlier. Thanks for getting Gemma's scarf!
"What are you spacing out for? You okay?
"That's cruel! Just because the village raised the Luminary, they did this?!
"After they caught you, I bet Heliodor soldiers came and burned it all.
"While you were spacing out, your mark and the roots on the tree were glowing. Did you see something again?
{var:1} told Erik what he had just seen.
"...Huh, how strange. You went back in time and met the villagers and your grandpa.
"You must have the power to see the past through these roots.
"All right, let's trust the old man's words and go see this Cobblestone Falls.
"Cobblestone Falls is east, past the village exit, right?
"I know it hurts, but staying here gets us nowhere. Let's go, {var:1}!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Dig under the triangular rock and something comes out... Just like you said.
"Two letters, it looks like. One is pretty beat up. Read it, {var:1}.
{var:1} took the tattered letter and read it.
{var:1}... By the time you can read this letter, I will no longer be in this world.
Soon after you were born, our homeland Dundrasil was attacked by monsters. I could barely manage to help you escape.
Listen, {var:1}. When a kind soul has raised you well, seek out the king of Heliodor, Dundrasil's ally.
You are Dundrasil's proud prince. And do not forget that you are also the Luminary, who carries a great mission.
The Luminary is the one who drives out the great darkness. One day you will understand what these words mean.
{var:1}... I'm sorry I couldn't stay with you. Forgive your powerless... mother...
"...............It looks like your mother's letter. How about the other one?
{var:1} took the other letter and read it.
To my dear grandson {var:1},
After meeting you from the future, I buried something here to guide you, as promised.
Have you read your mother's letter? It came along with you when you washed ashore.
Following that letter, I sent you to Heliodor, but it seems that caused you pain.
Why was Dundrasil attacked, and why is the Luminary called the Darkspawn? I had no idea.
Then the truth must be seen with your own eyes. I give you a keystone that opens the door of the Door of Departure to the east.
Use it to travel the world and seek the truth. The truth of how you became the hunted Luminary called Darkspawn...
{var:1}, do not hold a grudge against anyone. I was happy to be your grandpa.
{var:1} obtained the Keystone!
"A keystone that opens the Door of Departure... Well, I've come this far. I'll keep traveling with you.
"The Door of Departure your grandpa mentioned is east of here, right? Then let's get going.
"...is what I'd like to say, but first let me settle my own business.
"The Red Orb was moved to Heliodor Temple, down this road. Count on me, {var:1}.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_050_cs_110.pack|cs_: "{var:1}!! The stone!! Take out the stone your grandpa gave you!!
"We won't let you escape!! Darkspawn who brings calamity!!
"{var:1}... I won't let you go. I'll chase you to the ends of the earth...
"Phew. Looks like we got away somehow.
"But where are we? There's nothing as far as the eye can see...
